selection: Highest arithmetic mean synthetic-vs-normal AP over 3 domains, 3 inner folds and 2 corruption profiles among multiscale candidates. Ties use smaller power.
inner_split: 3-fold with shuffle seed 2026, on original proper-fit normals only
profiles: For each held-out bag select ceil(0.05 * bag length) random descriptors and ceil(sqrt(dimension)) random coordinates, shared across these descriptors. Swap coordinates for the same positions of a randomly sampled fit bag, or add a shared signed Uniform(1,2) * (Q90-Q10) shift computed from inner-fit data.
score: For k in {5,20}, divide mean standardized neighbor distance by median training radius^(1-b) times local radius^b. Local radius is the mean leave-self-out radius of the k neighbors, floored at the tenth percentile of training radii. Use the geometric mean across k; average the top ceil(0.02*m) patch values.
